facts.fact: The OECD, World Bank and AfDB MAPS assessment says South Africa's organs of state publish tenders on the eTenders e-procurement system, with 73% of registered organs of state publishing tenders in financial year 2023-2024.
The MAPS assessment gives eTenders use figures for 2023-2024: 73% of registered organs of state published tenders, 12% uploaded procurement plans and 3% published contract notices.
